correctness.rationale: The subgroup lattice is the subspace lattice. Lines can only be dominated by hyperplanes, forcing a zero common intersection and hence at least d selected hyperplanes. Such d hyperplanes form a clique and dominate all vertices. Dual-basis counting and the even-cardinality constraint give the remaining formulas. The checker verifies six small parameter cases.
